# KK Studio instructions

Before editing, read root `RULES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `AI_RULES.md`, then `docs/FIGMA-SYNC.md` (for UI/tokens), `docs/engineering/SDLC.md`, `docs/engineering/BRANCH-POLICY.md`, `docs/engineering/REVIEW.md`, `docs/engineering/PROMPTING.md`, and current `docs/governance/` sources. Understand the user's natural language and produce a scoped engineering brief; never make drive-by edits outside the task scope (`RULE-NO-DRIVEBY`). Use task branches, actual tests, and independent review; never direct-push main, force-push, or delete protected refs. Summarize in concise Chinese.
